name: Lark (Larksuite)
one_liner: Enterprise collaboration platform (Lark) with messaging, calendar, docs and video, exposed via OpenAPIs.
auth_notes: App ID/App Secret yield tenant_access_token (app identity) or user_access_token via standard OAuth 2.0; sent in HTTP headers. International platform is open.larksuite.com; Feishu (open.feishu.cn) is the separate CN platform.
access_notes: Custom apps created self-serve in the Developer Console; each API scope needs enterprise administrator approval before calls work. Store apps limited to ISV-qualified users. Pricing/plan gating of API not found (plans page returned no text).

buildability.rationale: Self-serve custom app credentials and documented OAuth OpenAPIs, but each scope needs per-tenant admin approval; store distribution restricted to ISVs. Intl Lark vs Feishu need separate domains.

needs_human_reason: Docs pages are JS-rendered (rate limits, event guide, plans returned no text); rate limits and sandbox unverified.

evidence.quote: only after the enterprise administrator approves can the application proceed with subsequent API calls or event listening.
(Only ISV-qualified users can create store apps.)
This is the Feishu/Lark official OpenAPI MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool
Traditional webhook mode, requiring you to provide a public internet address for receiving event messages.

disputes.why: llms.txt states API calls require enterprise administrator approval of scopes.
Scope/data-permission review by tenant admin is required; store apps also need ISV qualification.
Official local MCP at github.com/larksuite/lark-openapi-mcp (npm @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp); no hosted URL, so exists stays official.
HTTP OpenAPIs with header tokens; REST-style, SDKs wrap them.
llms.txt lists messaging, calendar, docs, bitable, contacts, CoreHR etc.; count not verified.
